### About This Product

Enjoy the ultimate in mobility self-empowerment with the Drive Bath Bench with Back and Arms, guaranteed to create a bathing experience that is safe, carefree and pleasant. Built for individuals who require additional safety measures that assist with mobility and balance while entering and exiting the bath or shower, this state-of-the-art seat has been designed to comfortably accommodate all shapes and sizes. The lightweight design features large, stable legs complemented by soft, non-slip feet, ensuring safety at all times, and also offers tool-free height adjustment. The back, legs and arms can be removed as well, making it flexible and easy to store or transport. Designed for maximum comfort, efficiency, safety and ease of use, the Drive Bath Bench is strong, durable and dependable-everything you need in a bathing safety seat.

### Highlights

- Easy, tool-free height adjustment with height indicator
- Seat height adjusts from 16 in. to 20.5 in. in 1/2 in. increments
- Enhanced comfort seat fits all shapes and sizes
- Back, legs and arms can be easily removed without tools
- Lightweight design features large, stable legs with soft, non-slip feet to ensure safety

## Product Description 

 The Drive Medical Bathroom Bench with Back and Arms is designed to provide seniors, adults, and individuals with limited mobility a safe, stable, and comfortable seating solution for the bathroom. Ideal for bathing, showering, or personal hygiene, this bench is suitable for a wide range of bathtub styles and requires no tools for easy setup. Constructed from durable, high-quality plastic, the bathroom bench is built to withstand daily use and support up to 350 lb, providing peace of mind for users and caregivers alike. The smooth, easy-to-clean surface ensures long-lasting durability. The adjustable legs, which extend in 0.5-inch increments, allow users to customize the seat height between 16 and 20.5 inches, promoting ergonomic comfort and making entry and exit from the tub safer. The bench measures 21.75 inches wide with outside leg dimensions of 17 inches by 15.5 inches, offering a secure and spacious seating area. Safety is enhanced through suction-style tips on each leg while built-in drainage holes reduce water buildup for added stability. The supportive backrest and armrests provide additional comfort and confidence during use, allowing individuals to maintain independence while bathing. Since 2000, Drive Medical has proudly manufactured trusted medical equipment and homecare products that are used in homes and hospitals across the globe. We offer a wide range of products to support your family’s needs, from mobility to bath safety, from patient care to personal care. Our mission is simple: to enhance the lives of our customers with products that support safety, independence, and comfort. When you shop from Drive Medical, you’ll find unmatched quality, cutting-edge innovation, and products designed in partnership with clinical experts.

This one was well reviewed and seemed reasonably priced. After only one use, I can tell with confidence that this is the one to buy for most folks. It is easy to assemble (mere minutes), is robustly constructed, very flexible (back and arm rests on or off as you wish), wider seating area than most (but not too wide to cause problems fitting the space), easy to adjust legs independently (really important because neither bathtubs or showers have flat floors), strong, no metal to rust. My highest endorsement!

properties.description: Top of the Line Safety and Bathing Support The Drive Medical Premium Series Shower Chair with Back and Arms is the ultimate in mobility self-empowerment. As a user, you are guaranteed your bathing experience will be one that is safe, carefree and pleasant. Built for individuals who require additional safety measures that assist you with mobility and balance while entering and exiting the bath or shower, this state of the art seat has been designed to comfortably accommodate all shapes and sizes. The lightweight design comes with large stable legs which are complimented by soft non-slip feet, ensuring your safety at all times. It also comes with tool free height adjustment. The back, as well as the legs and arms can also be removed as well, making it an item that is flexible, easy to store, pack away and transport. Designed to give you maximum comfort, efficiency, safety, and ease of use, the Drive Safety Shower Chair is strong, durable and dependable. It's everything you need in a shower safety bench seat.If you experience dizziness, or you're unsure of your footing due to mobility issues when it comes time to bathe...You can now help rid yourself of this stress and worry as bathing once again becomes relaxing and pleasurable, thanks to Drive Medical's Premium Series Shower Chair with Back and Arms. Go ahead...Experience the Drive Difference Now!
